name: CDP-dependent phosphatidylglycerol and phosphatidylcholine synthesis
rationale: All members are CDP-diacylglycerol/CDP-choline routes to PG and PC (including PG remodeling), distinguishing it from neighbours centred on PA/DAG/TAG synthesis or cardiolipin.

name: Spindle orientation and centrosome positioning in neural progenitor division
rationale: Members cover spindle/astral microtubule orientation, centrosome localization and asymmetric division, with forebrain neuroblast/neural stem cell division members that the centriole/microtubule-nucleation confusables lack.

qualifier: Pol I elongation/termination and early spacer cleavage
name: rRNA transcription elongation-termination and pre-rRNA spacer cleavage
rationale: All members concern rRNA synthesis by Pol I (plus 5S by Pol III) elongation/termination and ETS/ITS1/ITS2 endonucleolytic cleavage, unlike confusables focused on Pol I initiation/regulation, Pol III machinery or late ribosome assembly.

name: Purine salvage and phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate synthesis
rationale: Members are purine base/nucleoside salvage (APRT, HPRT1, IMP, guanine) and its PRPP co-substrate synthesis, distinguishing it from purine catabolism and de novo synthesis confusables.

qualifier: sleep, stress and social/reproductive behavior via neuropeptide GPCRs
name: Neuropeptide GPCR control of sleep, stress and social behavior
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/opioid/orexin/relaxin GPCR signaling with sleep-wake, stress, mating, parental and feeding behaviors, which the drug-response, feeding-only and corticotropin-secretion confusables lack.

name: Toxic metal ion response and heme oxygenase-1 regulation
rationale: Members are responses to mercury, lead, cobalt, selenium and iron ions plus HMOX1 and hydrogen peroxide regulation, distinguishing it from MTF1/metallothionein zinc-copper-cadmium and iron-transport confusables.

name: Nucleotide sugar transport and UDP-glucuronate formation
rationale: All three members provide activated nucleotide sugars (UDP-GlcNAc and nucleotide sugar transport, UDP-glucuronate formation), unlike confusables on SLC35 transport defects, UDP-GlcNAc synthesis, N-glycan processing or PAPS.

name: Iron and heme uptake with scavenger receptor clearance
rationale: Members cover transferrin/iron import, heme scavenging and iron-overload disorders together with class A/B/F/H scavenger receptor clearance, which the metal-ion transport and oxygen-transport confusables lack.

qualifier: anteroposterior, neural plate border and hindbrain segmentation
name: Anteroposterior neural plate patterning, border specification, hindbrain segmentation
rationale: Members specify anterior/posterior neural plate, neural plate border and neural crest, midbrain-hindbrain boundary, rhombomeres and anterior HOX activation, contrasting with dorsoventral, axial mesoderm and spinal cord confusables.

qualifier: Fas and TRAIL, including T-cell activation-induced death
name: Fas and TRAIL death receptor apoptosis regulation
rationale: Members regulate extrinsic Fas/TRAIL/TNF death receptor apoptosis (BID, T-cell AICD, thymocyte and hepatocyte apoptosis), unlike confusables centred on caspase-8/c-FLIP activation or necroptosis.

qualifier: cancer receptor/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 targets
name: TGF-beta–SMAD2/3 signaling, cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets
rationale: Members are TGF-beta receptor/SMAD signaling, its downregulation and TGFBR3 control, cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMADs, and RUNX3 target genes, distinguishing it from activin and RUNX3-YAP/Hippo confusables.

qualifier: FGFR2 downstream cascades and activating FGFR1/2/4 mutants
name: FGFR2 downstream cascades and activating FGFR1/2/4 mutants
rationale: Members are FRS/SHC/PLC cascades downstream of FGFR2 and activated point mutants of FGFR1, FGFR2 and FGFR4, unlike confusables on ligand binding or FGFR3/FGFR1 cascades.

name: Cellular senescence with heterochromatin and Polycomb silencing
rationale: Members are replicative, oncogene- and stress-induced senescence, SASP, SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin and BMI1 Polycomb modules, which the p53/G0-G1-centred senescence confusables lack.

name: MHC class I cross-presentation of exogenous antigens
rationale: All members are endosomal/phagosomal cross-presentation routes of exogenous antigen on MHC class I, unlike endogenous class I loading, proteasome or MHC class II confusables.

core: Immunoregulatory receptor control of lymphocyte activation
name: Immunoregulatory receptor control of T, NK and dendritic cells
rationale: Members regulate T cell costimulation, NK activation and dendritic cell differentiation/activation via lymphoid–non-lymphoid receptor interactions, distinguishing it from KIR, resting DC and Treg/tolerance confusables.

name: BDNF–TrkB neurotrophin receptor signaling
rationale: All members are BDNF responses or NTRK2 signaling (via CDK5, RAC1, synaptic modulation), unlike NGF-ERK5/CREB and postsynaptic structure confusables.

core: Steroid and vitamin D hormone synthesis
name: Steroid and vitamin D hormone synthesis, phosphate-mineral homeostasis
rationale: Members span adrenal/gonadal steroidogenesis and its CYP defects, vitamin D metabolism and FGF23-Klotho/NaPi phosphate handling with tooth and bone mineralization, distinguishing it from thyroid, retinoid and vitamin K confusables.

name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: All three members are estrogen or progesterone receptor responses, unlike thyroid hormone, mammary development and androgen receptor confusables.

name: Cytoplasmic translation initiation and peptide elongation
rationale: Members are 43S/eIF3 assembly, scanning, start codon recognition, 60S joining and elongation, unlike rRNA synthesis/processing and translation termination/NMD confusables.

name: Neurexin–neuroligin excitatory synapse assembly and EPSP regulation
rationale: Members are neurexin-neuroligin, PSD-95/NMDA receptor clustering, postsynaptic membrane assembly and EPSP regulation, distinguishing it from inhibitory synapse and SALM/RPTP adhesion confusables.

name: Type 2 immunity via Th2 cytokines and eosinophils
rationale: Members are Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13/33 signaling and production, eosinophil and mast cell development and IgE switching, unlike broad interleukin, FcεRI degranulation and Th17/IL-10 confusables.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage, lipophagy and LXR control
rationale: Members regulate triglyceride storage, lipid droplet organization/disassembly and lipophagy, with NR1H2/3 (LXR) lipogenic/lipolytic gene control that the TAG synthesis, lipolysis and adipocyte confusables lack.

qualifier: PD-L1 turnover and HIV Nef/Vpu targets
name: PD-L1 turnover and HIV Nef/Vpu surface receptor downregulation
rationale: Members are PD-L1 glycosylation/degradation and HIV Nef/Vpu removal of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I with T cell anti-tumor regulation, unlike MHC-I presentation and proteasome confusables.

name: Bidirectional regulation of PDGF receptor signaling
rationale: All three members positively or negatively regulate PDGF receptor (including PDGFR-beta) signaling, unlike fibroblast/EMT and downstream ERK/PI3K confusables.

name: Locomotor, exploratory and reflex motor behavior
rationale: Most members are motor behaviors (walking, swimming, grooming, exploration, righting reflex) with amygdala and Purkinje layer development as motor/affective brain-region members, distinguishing it from synaptic transmission, vocal/sensory and proprioception confusables.
